ImageDescription.value: Aerial view of department store the Bijenkorf on the Schiedamse Vest and Schiedamsesingel. In the foreground the G.K. van Hogendorpsplein and surroundings, in the background on the left the Leuvehaven and the Wijnhaven. From the southwest. Year: 1938.
